assumptions: ctx=min(8192,model max), KV cache F16, engine reserve/headroom per platform; one-unit GB10 rows count GGUF weights at file size, calibrated on llama.cpp/Ollama logs with flash attention on (the default) — flash attention off and single-unit vLLM need more and are not budgeted

definitions.predicted_total_to_run_gb: Total memory required to RUN: weights + KV cache + linear-attention state + runtime overhead + OS/GPU reserve. This is what the verdict uses. (used_gb is its v1 alias.)
definitions.linear_state_gb: Fixed recurrent state of hybrid linear-attention (Gated DeltaNet) layers. Unlike KV cache this does NOT grow with context — it is a constant per sequence. Exactly 0 for standard full/sliding attention models.
definitions.predicted_resident_weights_gb: Predicted resident model weights incl. non-quantized parts (+12% of the quantized weights; one GB10 unit counts GGUF weights at file size, +0%) — compare against idle_resident measurements.
definitions.measurement_kind: What the measured number is: idle_resident (resident weights floor, e.g. oMLX actual_size) / load_peak / generation_peak / system_total_peak / allocation_floor (the runtime's own logged allocations or a per-process nvidia-smi snapshot — a floor without OS share, CUDA context or host memory the source does not show). Only system_total_peak is directly comparable to predicted_total_to_run_gb; idle_resident readings SHOULD be lower than the total — that is not a prediction error.
definitions.measurement_match: same_ctx = measured at this row’s ctx; different_ctx = measured under a different context length (KV portion not directly comparable).
definitions.units: Predicted *_gb columns are GiB-based (1024³), matching nvidia-smi/Activity Monitor style labels; measured_unit records the measurement’s own unit if reported.
